text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience, and I’d be glad to help fix your scraping issue.

I’ve built production systems with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Next.js, including a streaming chat widget for Quillstack where I built the front end and Node proxy for token-by-token responses, reaching first token on screen in about 600 ms. I also built a booking platform for fitness studios for Pulsebox Studios, which onboarded 64 studios in 6 months.

For your app, I’d look at the server-side scraping flow, CORS handling, timeouts, and any deployment-specific differences between localhost and AWS/Heroku. I can help identify why it works locally but fails on the server and get it running reliably.
